name: runbook-compiler-monorepo
description: Runbook Compiler reference implementation and RunbookBench research suite

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" run build
scripts.local:compile: pnpm --filter @runbook/compiler build && mkdir -p .local && node packages/compiler/dist/cli.js compile fixtures/runbooks/royal-duke-cooling-incident.md --plan fixtures/compile-plans/royal-duke-cooling-incident.json --manifest fixtures/manifests/royal-duke-operations.json --output .local/royal-duke-cooling-incident.rbir.json
scripts.local:bench: pnpm --filter @runbook/bench test && node packages/bench/dist/cli.js validate fixtures/bench-corpus --allow-draft
scripts.local:bench:publish: pnpm --filter @runbook/bench build && node packages/bench/dist/cli.js validate fixtures/bench-corpus
scripts.local:smoke: pnpm --filter @runbook/compiler build && pnpm --filter @runbook/broker build && pnpm --filter @runbook/control build && pnpm --filter @runbook/royal-duke-worker build && node scripts/local-smoke.mjs
scripts.fleet:deploy: uv run --python 3.13 --with-requirements agents/royal-duke-fleet/requirements.txt agents/royal-duke-fleet/deploy.py --project project-87ae1ae6-1a71-468d-943 --location us-central1 --gateway projects/project-87ae1ae6-1a71-468d-943/locations/us-central1/agentGateways/royal-duke-egress
